confidence_notes: Restaurant and beer anchors rest on several aggregated city cost sources in search snippets that broadly agree (cappuccino about 2 USD, simple lunch about 2.2 to 2.6 USD, mid-range three-course about 8 to 9 USD per person) and on general knowledge of Jakarta pricing. Accommodation is the weakest area: hotel aggregator averages conflict and mix hotel categories, so hotel_3star_2p is a judgement-based estimate and may be low for central locations. Hostel dorm figures come from consistent aggregator averages, but the private room and basic hotel anchors are inferred from dorm and listing data. Cocktail and wine_glass use the local price relationship to beer (about three times beer for cocktails, about three times beer for wine), plus cocktail averages from World's 50 Best and Expatistan snippets. Prices are approximate tourist-level figures that include typical tax and service. FX: the RBA exchange-rates table snippet shows 0.6947 for 16 October 2026, while the RBA overview and homepage show 0.6955 for 15 October; the 16 October figure may be provisional, so verify on the RBA page before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Southeast Asian capital-city basis, using aggregated Jakarta cost-of-living and hostel/hotel listing averages where available, with restaurant and beer prices cross-checked against typical SEA capital levels and cocktail and wine prices scaled from the beer anchor.
